title: Readmission During a Facility Stay, Visits Added on Issue Under Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, a readmission during a facility stay adds visits to an authorization issued after reconsideration.

## Source records

From the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines: the start (service date) of the patient's most recent acute inpatient admission line, the start of the patient's most recent skilled nursing facility line, and whether an emergency department visit line of the patient is dated in the last month.

## Terms

1. Where the patient's most recent acute inpatient admission began after the start of the patient's most recent skilled nursing facility line, **4 visits** are added.
2. Where that is not so, but an emergency department visit of the patient is dated in the last month, **2 visits** are added.
3. Otherwise none are added.

## Truth table

| Most recent admission began after the most recent facility line's start | Emergency visit dated in the last month | Visits added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | 4 |
| no, or either line absent | yes | 2 |
| no, or either line absent | no | 0 |

## Example (hypothetical)

A patient's most recent skilled nursing facility line starts on 1 March and the most recent acute admission began on 9 March: 4 visits are added.
